entries.name: ARP4754
entries.definition: An SAE International recommended practice with guidelines for developing civil aircraft and their systems, including requirements and development assurance.

entries.name: Arquillian
entries.definition: A Java testing framework that runs tests inside a real container or server so that code can be tested in its target environment.

entries.name: Arranging catering
entries.definition: Organising food and drink service for an event, including choosing caterers, menus and quantities.

entries.name: Arranging conferences
entries.definition: Planning and organising a conference, including its venue, schedule, speakers and attendee logistics.

entries.name: Art education
entries.definition: The teaching and learning of the visual arts, and the study of how to teach them.

entries.name: Art history
entries.definition: The academic study of the history of visual art, including its styles, artists and the contexts in which it was made.

entries.name: Art theory
entries.definition: The study of the principles, purposes and meaning of the visual arts and of how they are made, judged and interpreted.

entries.name: Arterial blood gas testing
entries.definition: A blood test on a sample taken from an artery that measures oxygen, carbon dioxide and the acid-base balance of the blood.

entries.name: Artificial intelligence
entries.definition: The field of computer science concerned with building systems that perform tasks that normally need human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning and perception.

entries.name: Artificial intelligence risk
entries.definition: The study of the harms that artificial intelligence systems can cause, such as bias, security failures and misuse, and of how to reduce them.

entries.name: ArtStation
entries.definition: An online platform where digital artists, mainly in games, film and animation, show portfolios and sell assets.

entries.name: As-built drawings
entries.definition: Preparing or reading drawings that record a building or system as it was actually built, including changes made during construction.

entries.name: ASC 340
entries.definition: The FASB Accounting Standards Codification topic on other assets and deferred costs, such as capitalised costs of obtaining and fulfilling customer contracts.

entries.name: Ashampoo Burning Studio
entries.definition: Software made by Ashampoo for burning data, music and video to CDs, DVDs and Blu-ray discs.

entries.name: ASP.NET Core MVC
entries.definition: A Microsoft web framework for building web apps and APIs with the model-view-controller pattern on ASP.NET Core.

entries.name: ASP.NET Identity
entries.definition: Microsoft's membership system for adding user accounts, sign-in and role-based authorization to ASP.NET applications.

entries.name: ASP.NET Web API
entries.definition: A Microsoft framework for building HTTP-based web services and APIs on .NET.

entries.name: Asphalt batch mix plant
entries.definition: A production facility that dries and heats aggregate and mixes it with bitumen in measured batches to make hot-mix asphalt.

entries.name: Assembly drawing
entries.definition: Preparing or reading technical drawings that show how the parts of a product or machine fit together.

entries.name: Assessing patient needs
entries.definition: Evaluating a patient's physical, emotional and practical needs so that their care can be planned.

entries.name: Asset turnover
entries.definition: A financial ratio that compares a company's sales with its assets to show how efficiently the assets are used to generate revenue.

entries.name: Asthma education
entries.definition: Teaching people with asthma and their caregivers to recognise triggers, use medicines and inhalers correctly and follow an asthma action plan.

entries.name: Async/await
entries.definition: A programming pattern, supported by syntax in languages such as C#, JavaScript and Python, that lets asynchronous operations be written in code that reads like sequential steps.

entries.name: Athletic training
entries.definition: The health-care field concerned with preventing, assessing, treating and rehabilitating injuries and illnesses related to sport and physical activity.

entries.name: Atlassian Confluence
entries.definition: Atlassian's web-based team workspace and wiki for creating, organising and sharing documents and project knowledge.

entries.name: Atlassian Crucible
entries.definition: Atlassian's web-based tool for peer code review, in which developers comment on each other's changes before they are accepted.

entries.name: Atomic layer deposition
entries.definition: A thin-film deposition technique that builds a material one atomic layer at a time through alternating, self-limiting gas-phase surface reactions.

entries.name: AtScale
entries.definition: A semantic-layer platform that sits between data warehouses and business-intelligence tools so that different tools use the same business definitions of data.

entries.name: Attorney-client privilege
entries.definition: The legal protection that keeps confidential communications between a lawyer and client, made to obtain legal advice, from being disclosed without the client's consent.

entries.name: auditd
entries.definition: The user-space daemon of the Linux Audit system, which collects kernel audit events and writes them to log files for security auditing.

entries.name: Auditing
entries.definition: Examining records, processes or systems to check that they are accurate and comply with requirements or controls.

entries.name: Auditing inpatient coding
entries.definition: Reviewing the diagnosis and procedure codes assigned to hospital inpatient stays to check that they are accurate, supported by the record and compliant with coding rules.

entries.name: Auditing outpatient coding
entries.definition: Reviewing the diagnosis and procedure codes assigned to outpatient (ambulatory) encounters to check that they are accurate, supported by the record and compliant with coding rules.

entries.name: Aural rehabilitation
entries.definition: Therapy and training that help people with hearing loss communicate, using residual hearing, hearing devices, speech-reading and communication strategies.

entries.name: Aurelia
entries.definition: An open-source JavaScript front-end framework for building single-page web applications.

entries.name: Author-it
entries.definition: Software for writing, managing and publishing technical documentation and other content from reusable components.

entries.name: Authorised capital
entries.definition: The maximum amount of share capital a company is permitted to issue under its constitutional documents.

entries.name: Autism therapy
entries.definition: Providing therapies and interventions, such as applied behavior analysis and speech, occupational and social-skills therapy, for people on the autism spectrum.

entries.name: Auto glass installation and repair
entries.definition: Replacing and repairing vehicle windshields and windows, including removing damaged glass and bonding in new glass.

entries.name: Autodesk 123D
entries.definition: A discontinued family of free Autodesk apps for 3D modelling, scanning and digital fabrication.
